name: The Harvest Terror

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Block on the facing page (PDF 563). Spell save DC 15 and +7 to hit are computed (Charisma +4, proficiency +3); the book gives no spellcasting numbers.

traits.name: Demonic Mimicry
traits.summary: Copies any voice or sound it has heard; a listener sees through it with a DC 18 Wisdom (Insight) check.
traits.text: The terror can imitate voices and noises it has heard. A listener can tell the imitation for what it is with a successful DC 18 Wisdom (Insight) check.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.summary: Three times a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When the terror fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead, 3 times a day.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Unraveling Song
traits.summary: Its one weakness to Charm: an Influence action playing or singing its old song Charms it until the end of that creature's next turn.
traits.text: Its Charmed immunity has one gap. As an Influence action a creature can play or sing the favourite song of the scarecrow that was Jericho Sticks, "Virgil's Birdcage"; the terror is then Charmed until the end of that creature's next turn. The charm ends early if that creature damages the terror or forces it to make a saving throw.

traits.name: Regional Effects (Lair)
traits.summary: Within a mile of its lair: its enemies have Disadvantage on Stealth checks, and everyone but the terror has Disadvantage on Deception checks made to keep a secret.
traits.text: Regional effects, within 1 mile of the Fields of the Crow while the terror lives and keeps its lair there. Amber Eyes: watching crows give the terror's enemies Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Spilled Secrets: creatures other than the terror have Disadvantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to keep a secret. Both end the moment it dies or moves its lair.

actions.name: Claw
actions.summary: +7, reach 5 ft, 1d8+4 Slashing; a Medium or smaller target falls Prone.

actions.name: Dirge of Secrets
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. Everyone within 30 ft: DC 15 Wis save or 2d10 Psychic and Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls (save again each turn; a minute at most). Half damage on a success.
actions.text: A hymn of stolen confidences rolls out from the terror. Each creature within 30 feet makes a DC 15 Wisdom save: on a failure it takes 11 (2d10) Psychic damage and has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns; after a minute it is free. A success takes half damage and has no further effect.

actions.name: Devour Secrets
actions.summary: Legendary only, once a round. Everyone within 20 ft: DC 15 Wis save (Disadvantage if it gave up a secret to the terror) or 2d6 Psychic and Speed 0 until the end of its next turn; half damage on a success.
actions.text: The terror's beak gapes and swallows what people have hidden. Each creature within 20 feet makes a DC 15 Wisdom save, at Disadvantage if it has handed the terror one of its secrets. A failure takes 7 (2d6) Psychic damage and has Speed 0 until the end of its next turn; a success takes half damage. Hit or miss, the terror can't do this again until its next turn begins.

options.name: Averting Winds
options.summary: Casts Wind Wall (not in a creature's space), no components, Charisma.
options.text: The terror casts Wind Wall with no components, using Charisma. The wall can't be placed in a creature's space.

options.name: Crow's Swoop
options.summary: Moves up to half its Speed with no Opportunity Attacks.

options.name: Devour Secrets
options.summary: 20-ft emanation, DC 15 Wis save: 2d6 Psychic and Speed 0 (Disadvantage if the target gave up a secret). Once a round.

summary: A crow-headed wicker demon with four black wings: it flies, claws and scythes, wails a dirge that dulls a whole party and eats secrets in a ring around itself; the song of the scarecrow it wears can charm it.

phases.name: Demon of Secrets
phases.summary: The murder bursts when Raum has eaten three crows or six have been caught or destroyed: his Legendary Resistance returns and Devour Secrets hungers.

minions.narration: The murder of crows scatters into black feathers and amber motes.

bonus_actions.name: Devour Crow
bonus_actions.summary: Eats an amber crow within 30 ft: 10, then 20, then 30 Temporary Hit Points. The third ends his murder phase.
bonus_actions.text: Raum swallows an amber crow within 30 feet and gains 10 Temporary Hit Points for the first, 20 for the second and 30 for the third. After the third the murder bursts.
